title: Plan
description: What the planner model returns for a confirmed goal: subtasks with dependencies (SPEC-02 r1 and r7). The harness checks it, gives each subtask a Uuid, and saves it as Subtask records. A Plan never leaves the harness as is; apps see the saved Subtasks.

Plan.description: The subtasks in plan order. The harness also rejects dependency cycles, unknown or duplicate ids, and plans longer than its limit, which this schema cannot express.

PlannedSubtaskId.description: A short id the planner picks, unique within the plan, used only for dependsOn. It is not stored: the harness gives each subtask a Uuid.

PlannedSubtask.description: One subtask as the planner proposes it. The router decides its lane (SPEC-03).

title.description: Short, shown on the dashboard and the cursor label.

dependsOn.description: Ids of the subtasks in this plan that must be done before this one starts.
